content.subject: Spend-to-invest card and reconciliation workflow
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. We help operations teams automate manual, reconciliation-heavy processes.

Saw that Episode Six and Sharesies launch New Zealand’s First Spend-to-Invest Debit Card. I imagine keeping payment, ledger, and bank reconciliation records aligned across systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We extract transaction data from your payment feeds and match it to ledger entries, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
